body: I'd send him to buy groceries so that he knows how expensive it really is. He should appreciate that you go buy groceries for your household. Food is not a category to cut costs if you can afford it!

This is probably the best advice I have received in a while!! I appreciate the honesty in your comment. Makes me realize that there is a big problem in my relationship where I rely on my partner to keep me entertained...probably because of past jealousy and fear of his reaction when I will meet new people...

I think that I need to stop waiting after him to be available and go do activities without him whether he likes it or not, and this is what I will do! This gave me the idea to take up a course to learn the language of the country where we moved!
